tracks.genre: 1980s power ballad AOR (big drums, synth pad, guitar solo)
tracks.subject: At 2 a.m. on a scaffold above a Bangkok Skytrain line, a billboard paster glues the giant panels of a diamond-ring advert and secretly writes his girlfriend's name and a proposal in the last corner, knowing she passes it at 8:10 every morning.
